ticker.alpha: ((0.35 + 0.05 * sin(0.25 * o.age)) * (1 - 0.25 * min(global.rain() * 2, 1))) * sin((PI / o.life) * o.age) * clamp((square(o.x - p.x) + square(o.z - p.z) - 1) / 25, 0, 1) * clamp((1024 - (square(o.x - p.x) + square(o.z - p.z))) / 256, 0, 1) * clamp((12 - abs(o.y - p.y)) / 4, 0, 1)
